title: PostgreSQL support
description: The sources require DATABASE_URL to select PostgreSQL when given a postgres:// or postgresql:// DSN, but TECHNOLOGY_STACK.md lists only SQLite. Absence is undecided, so the sources govern. Adds postgres.md and psycopg[binary] to the stack.

title: Concurrent command behavior (AC-005)
description: Two commands may run against one database at once. Each command runs as a single transaction and either commits or fails with no partial change. SQLite serializes writers; PostgreSQL uses default isolation. The persistence library's default connect timeout applies.

options.label: Serialize writes through the library's default transaction behavior

title: No-argument invocation
description: The sources do not state the response when ledger runs with no arguments. Chosen: the conventional usage error, exit 2, with one usage line on standard error.

title: Help response contract
description: The sources give no help text. Chosen: usage and arguments on standard output with exit 0, exempt from the CSV rule (AC-006).

title: Connect timeout (AC-004)
description: The timeout is not stated in the sources. Chosen: the persistence library's default connect timeout, with an expired connect exiting 1.

title: Amount conversion as its own story
description: FOUNDATION-004 needs a unit that is not a schema detail. Chosen: a conversion module owned by its own story, which validation and integrity stories depend on.

title: Seed file inputs in acceptance
description: The guardrail bars application code from reading seed files, but acceptance may pass them to ledger load as input. Chosen: acceptance uses them only through the ledger load command.

title: Authorize db-selection-unreachable runtime tooling
description: Authorize python-package=psycopg for runtime scope. Planned installation: uv add psycopg. Affected acceptance check: FEATURE-DATABASE-SELECTION.md#db-selection-unreachable (An unreachable PostgreSQL server raises PersistenceError instead of returning a database.).

title: Runner fallback and DSN form
description: When .venv/bin/python is absent the runner falls back to python3 on PATH. DATABASE_URL is exported as a plain temporary file path, not a sqlite:// URL, matching sources/run.sh. Is that acceptable?
system_choice: When .venv/bin/python is absent the runner falls back to python3 on PATH. DATABASE_URL is exported as a plain temporary file path, not a sqlite:// URL, matching sources/run.sh. Is that acceptable?

title: Indexes derived from the persistence declaration
description: The rendered schema indexes transactions(account); transactions(category). Each is implied by the declaration — a foreign key is looked up by its child column, and a read pattern's Input fields are the predicate it filters on. Declare an `- INDEX (...)` bullet in DATABASE.md for any index this does not cover.

title: Acceptance skipped: scaffold-pyproject
system_choice: Leave scaffold-pyproject untested until its acceptance setup is repaired; do not treat it as passed.
